```python
import datetime

current_time = datetime.datetime(2024, 5, 15, 10, 27, 54)

next_tuesday = schedule._move_to_next_weekday(current_time, 'tuesday')

monday = datetime.datetime(2024, 5, 13, 10, 27, 54)  # This is a Monday
next_monday = schedule._move_to_next_weekday(monday, 'monday')
print(f"Expected: May 13 (today), Got: May {next_monday.day}")
```

The function incorrectly adds 8 days instead of 7 when the target weekday is today, causing jobs to be scheduled too far in the future.
